algorithm: Whole-candidate residual pairwise logistic ranker with actual decoder path margins

training.feature_support_unit: Distinct (source,context,code,positive); authored variants collapsed to family

limitations: Local/skip/boundary evidence, not grammatical proof. Final correction clipping is a training approximation. Missing gold candidates do not train pairs. Repeated competitors and family variants are downweighted. This reranker preserves the existing displayed pool and cannot recover lost search paths.
selection: Separate existing authored60,natural200,Tatoeba200 validation; positive structural winner retained, remaining candidates reranked; fresh followup100 evaluated after selection.
structural_gate: Any original winner with positive existing completion/handover/clause/clause-start support retains first position; weaker score evidence cannot replace it. Other candidates keep full residual ordering. No full-sentence exception list.
training_observations: 800 HKCanCor train utterances,600 Tatoeba train families,240 authored training variants. Related competitors/family variants downweighted. Unreachable targets do not contribute candidate pairs.
